_description: Part 17 - evaluates whether the SearchDocument model carries enough deterministic, source-backed fields to compute Related A/B Tests / Journeys / Calculators / Blog Posts in the future. Explicitly does NOT build a new recommendation engine and does NOT publish new automatic related-content links this round (search-relations.json's own relatedPrimary/relatedSecondary computation for ab-test/journey is UNCHANGED by this file - see whatWasNotDone below). All numbers computed directly against the real, current search/search-relations.json and search/search-index.json.

currentRelationCoverage.measurementMethod: Cross-referenced every document's type against search-relations.json's relations map - counted how many of each type have a non-empty relatedPrimary and/or relatedSecondary.

byType.primarySource: calculator-catalog.json's own relatedCalculators field - explicit, authored, real (reason tag: explicit-product-relation)
byType.verdict: READY - full, explicit, source-backed coverage already.

byType.primarySource: each post's own related[] field in src/lib/blog-posts.ts (reason tag: explicit-content-relation)
byType.verdict: READY - full, explicit, source-backed coverage already.

byType.primarySource: none wired into relations.json before this round - see gapFoundAndFixed below
byType.verdict: WAS NOT READY (11% coverage, weak shared-category-only signal) - NOW HAS A REAL FIX AVAILABLE, see below.

byType.primarySource: no explicit per-record relation field exists in src/data/ab-tests.json (unlike calculators/blog posts) - confirmed by reading its own field list (id/slug/category/surface/question/hypothesis/setupType/comparisonMode/differenceBehavior/testedSlot/primaryKpi/otherKpis/whatToTest/guardrails/sideA/sideB/seoTitle/seoDescription - no relatedTests-shaped field anywhere)
byType.verdict: GENUINELY LIMITED BY SOURCE DATA - see noGapFound below, this is not a missing-field problem.

gapFoundAndFixed.finding: production/journey-view-model.json carries a real, explicit, source-authored `relationships` object per journey (relationships.handoffs[] and relationships.distinctFrom[], plus preemptedBy/competition) that was ALREADY being read by build-search-index.mjs (for the handoffTargets local variable) but only folded into free-text searchText ('Hands off to X, Y, Z') - never exposed as a structured, resolvable field a relations computation could actually use. This is exactly the kind of deterministic, source-backed field Part 17 asks to add if missing.
gapFoundAndFixed.whatWasAdded: A new, journey-only, OPTIONAL field `journeyRelationRefs: { handoffs: [{targetId}], distinctFrom: [{targetId, because}] }` on the SearchDocument model (search-document.types.ts, search-document.schema.json) and populated in build-search-index.mjs directly from relationships.handoffs/distinctFrom, filtering out any target that is external (isExternal:true, e.g. 'external:health-monitoring' - a conceptual handoff to a system outside the journey corpus, not a real document) or otherwise unresolvable - verified 0 targets point at merged/retired journey ids (production/journey-merged-id-contract.json's 5 ids never appear as a handoff/distinctFrom target), so no alias-resolution complexity was needed.
gapFoundAndFixed.verification: Re-ran build-search-index.mjs + search-validator.mjs (23/23 pass, including the schema-conformance check) + run-query-fixtures.mjs (67/67 pass, 3 documented known-gaps unchanged) after adding this field - 0 regressions.

noGapFound.ab-test: src/data/ab-tests.json has no explicit relatedness field of its own (confirmed by reading its full field list - see byType above). The SearchDocument model DOES already carry genuinely sufficient deterministic fields for a future ab-test relation computation to use beyond just shared-category (category, surface, funnelStage, businessObjective, metric are all already present per-ab-test-document) - the 11%->relatively-low coverage of the CURRENT relations.json is a limitation of what THAT FILE'S OWN GENERATOR currently computes (shared-category only, for ab-test/journey), not a missing field on SearchDocument. Combining surface+metric+businessObjective into a richer secondary-relation signal for ab-test (and journey, alongside the new handoffs field) is a real, legitimate future improvement - but it is IMPROVING THE RELATIONS COMPUTATION ITSELF, which crosses into 'building/expanding the recommendation engine', explicitly out of scope this round (rule: 'don't build a new recommendation engine'). Not undertaken here.
noGapFound.lab-product: Not named in Part 17's own list (A/B Tests/Journeys/Calculators/Blog Posts) - the 6 Lab product entries have 0 relation coverage today and none was investigated this round, consistent with the task's own scope.

whatWasNotDone._description: Explicit disclosure of what this round deliberately stopped short of, per the task's 'do not publish automatic related-content links this round' instruction.
items: search-relations.json's own relatedPrimary/relatedSecondary computation for journey documents was NOT changed to consume the new journeyRelationRefs field - it still only computes shared-category secondary relations for journeys, exactly as before this round.

No new relatedPrimary entries were added anywhere as a result of this evaluation - the new journeyRelationRefs field exists on SearchDocument as prepared, available, real data, but is not yet surfaced as a 'Related Journeys' recommendation anywhere.

ab-test's relation computation was not extended to use surface/metric/businessObjective, for the same reason - that is an improvement to the recommendation logic itself, not a missing-data-field fix, and is out of scope.

futureReadiness.calculator: PRODUCTION READY - no further data work needed.
futureReadiness.blog-article: PRODUCTION READY - no further data work needed.
futureReadiness.journey: DATA READY as of this round - journeyRelationRefs gives a future round real, 89%-coverage, source-backed material to compute an actual 'Related Journeys' feature from (handoffs = 'what happens next', distinctFrom = 'commonly confused with, but different because...' - two genuinely different, both useful relation semantics, correctly kept as two separate lists rather than merged into one undifferentiated 'related' bucket).
futureReadiness.ab-test: DATA ADEQUATE, COMPUTATION LIMITED - SearchDocument already carries enough fields (category/surface/funnelStage/businessObjective/metric) for a future relations-computation improvement to combine into a stronger signal than shared-category alone; no new field was needed or added here, since the constraint is in the relations generator's current scope, not the data model.
